Influencer's Diwali Sweet Request Leads to Fake COD Orders

An Indian influencer's request for Diwali sweets, shared online with his address, resulted in him receiving fake Cash on Delivery (COD) orders for a ₹1.69 lakh television. The incident, described as a nightmare ordeal, went viral.
